gen-vast-shadow-gf-liter: Vast Shadow cuts every stroke to a single width and stands tall, with generous gaps between letters. Liter follows with no stroke contrast at all and wide-mouthed round forms, so paragraphs stay easy to move through.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-mada: Mada reads friendly and upright, its curves left open and its midzone towering over everything around it. Vast Shadow supplies the vintage punch up top.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-major-mono-display: Vast Shadow is vintage and eye-catching, tall and loosely spaced. Major Mono Display brings neon-tube strokes and wide sidebearings, so a monospace paragraph moves slowly, with a precise, technical tick to every character.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-martel-sans: Modern and open, Martel Sans keeps a high mean line across every word and generous curves. And Vast Shadow, with unbroken line width on each letter, would lose its punch if shrunk down small.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-martian-mono: Vast Shadow is vintage, tall and showy. Martian Mono, a fixed-width monospace with far-apart letters, does the structured, technical work of carrying text, while the heading simply grabs attention.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-matangi: Chunky, vintage and loud up top, then twine-like strokes below. Matangi keeps its rounded letters open and its lowercase hefty, so it holds its ground beside Vast Shadow's tall, widely spaced capitals.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-maven-pro: Vintage in mood, Vast Shadow cuts every stroke to one width and stands tall. And Maven Pro, gentle in line thickness with a high-waisted lowercase, would swamp that heading if the body were set large.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-michroma: Vast Shadow's strokes keep one width, edges running parallel through every curve. Michroma gives each letter a wide berth and a tall-bodied lowercase, doing the quiet, professional work of text while the heading draws the eye.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-miriam-libre: Miriam Libre reads sturdy and friendly, with wire-like strokes and a lowercase as tall as cast iron capitals. And paragraphs in it feel open and easy, a good foil to Vast Shadow's vintage loudness.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: Approachable and clean, Mochiy Pop P One leaves wide gaps between its sizable lowercase letters, with no brush-like swell. Vast Shadow stands tall above it, vintage and loud.
